Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class CombinedConstraint

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.CombinedConstraint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constraint, Jacobian
public final class CombinedConstraint extends Object implements Constraint, Jacobian
Concatenation of several LinearConstraint / NonlinearConstraint objects into a single Constraint + Jacobian that the orchestrator can pass straight to EqualityConstrainedSQP.eqSQP(de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.IFunctionAndConstraint, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.IGradientAndJacobian, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.LagrangeHessian, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, double, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.StoppingCriterion, de.labathome.trustconstr.records.State, double, double, de.labathome.trustconstr.enums.ProjectionMethod, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.LinearOperator) or TrustRegionInteriorPoint.trustRegionInteriorPoint(java.util.function.ToDoubleBiFunction<de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, java.lang.Object>, java.util.function.BiFunction<de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, java.lang.Object, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix>, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.LagrangeHessian, int, int, int, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.Constraint, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.Jacobian, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, double, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix, de.labathome.trustconstr.interfaces.GlobalStoppingCriteria, boolean[], double, de.labathome.trustconstr.records.State, double, double, double, double, de.labathome.trustconstr.enums.ProjectionMethod).

The combined constraint stacks all equality rows from all sources, then all inequality rows from all sources. This mirrors scipy's CanonicalConstraint.concatenate on a smaller scale (without the Hessian-of-Lagrangian aggregation, which the orchestrator currently doesn't use for nonlinear constraints).

Each input must implement both Constraint and Jacobian and expose its nEq() / nIneq() via the value-class types LinearConstraint or NonlinearConstraint.

    • lagrangianContribution

      public Matrix lagrangianContribution(Matrix x, double[] vEq, double[] vIneq)
      Sum of constraint-Hessian-of-Lagrangian contributions across all sources. Walks the constraint list, slices vEq/vIneq into the portions that belong to each source (in declaration order), and sums the resulting Hessians.
      Parameters:
      x - iterate (n x 1)
      vEq - equality multipliers, length nEq()
      vIneq - inequality multipliers, length nIneq()
      Returns:
      summed n x n constraint Hessian, or null if no source contributes (e.g. every source is a LinearConstraint, which has zero Hessian)
